subject: Mythology
title: Why African Mythology Matters Now
description: A micro-lesson that makes Why African Mythology Matters Now usable.

hook.text: For centuries, African mythology was dismissed as primitive. Now the world is finally recognizing its depth and genius.

buildup.text: African myths contain sophisticated ideas about ecology, community, justice, and the bond between humans and nature.

discovery.text: Ubuntu philosophy — 'I am because we are' — comes from African mythology and now influences global ethics and policy.

twist.text: Climate scientists study African ecological myths for traditional knowledge about living sustainably with the land.

climax.text: African mythology is not a relic. It is a living tradition that has answers the modern world desperately needs.

punchline.text: The world ignored Africa's wisdom for centuries. Now it cannot afford to.

quiz.question: What African philosophical concept now influences global ethics?
options: Griot memorization techniques for education reform
Ubuntu — 'I am because we are' — emphasizing community interdependence
Ifa divination methods for business decision-making
